payload.early_survival_model: EXP-006 generalizes: a blocker with def<250 dies in ~12s per attacking uoffcr (empirical interval ~1.5s from the 295->654 trace). Therefore the lane-01 block must be def>=322 (char_445_wscoot) so that the queue-clear deadline is set by block-COUNT (route-4 pair at 805/941) rather than blocker death: with ~480-490 eDPS auto-cycle fire (char_4211_snhunt class: 650 atk, 2.3x every 3rd attack) established by ~frame 450-600, the queue route-1 -> route-28 clears every ~205 frames and never exceeds depth 2.
payload.economy_model: DP = 10 initial + 1.0/s natural (30 frames per DP). Envelope: 34.3 by frame 729, 41.37 by 941, 55 by 1350. The prior plans' bounds embed one fang-class +6 proc (47.3667@941). Legal economy levers never used by failed plans: (1) retreat refund from the [3,3] stub after it solos route-2 (~frame 390, +5 if full refund, rule to be verified); (2) a backfield battery pioneer on a path-free tile (e.g. [9,4], absent from all cluster path_segments): char_420_flamtl (cost 12, +6 DP per 18s auto cycle, first proc ~9s after deploy) yields +6 roughly every 540 frames through the mid-game; (3) deleting the standing medic via def>=322 blockers; (4) merging three ranged responsibilities into one SC_01 deployment.

A cheap durable block-1 body there (char_322_lmlee: cost 7, 1552 HP, 308 def, 25s redeploy) can dam route-1 alone indefinitely, splitting the pocket queue so downstream block-count and fire deadlines relax by ~200 frames.
